description:
Perform a mixed (split-plot) ANOVA on the BFI25 personality dataset to examine whether the pattern of Conscientiousness item endorsement differs between males and females.

The file 'BFI25.csv' is located at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25.csv'. It contains 25 Big Five personality items (A1-A5, C1-C5, E1-E5, N1-N5, O1-O5) rated on a 1-6 Likert scale, plus gender (1=Male, 2=Female) and age.

Expected Actions:
1. Open '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25.csv' in Jamovi.
2. Set the variable 'gender' to Nominal measure type (it imports as Continuous).
3. Navigate to Analyses > ANOVA > Repeated Measures ANOVA.
4. Define a Repeated Measures factor named 'CItem' with 5 levels.
5. Assign variables C1, C2, C3, C4, C5 to the 5 levels respectively.
6. Add 'gender' as a Between Subject Factor.
7. Under Assumption Checks, enable 'Sphericity tests' and 'Sphericity corrections' (Greenhouse-Geisser).
8. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/MixedANOVA_Conscientiousness.omv'.
9. Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/mixed_anova_report.txt' extracting the following statistics from the results tables (one per line):

Item_F: [CItem F-statistic]
Item_p: [CItem p-value]
Gender_F: [gender F-statistic]
Gender_p: [gender p-value]
Interaction_F: [CItem ✻ gender F-statistic]
Interaction_p: [CItem ✻ gender p-value]
GG_epsilon: [Greenhouse-Geisser epsilon]
Mauchly_significant: [yes or no]

Report F and epsilon values rounded to 3 decimal places. For very small p-values (p < .001), write '< 0.001'.
